description:
Calcula los tiempos de espera entre reintentos (exponencial, lineal o constante) con tope y jitter opcional. Cuándo: un flujo de agente necesita un resultado exacto y repetible para un paso auxiliar (tokens, costos, reintentos, fragmentos, ranking, limpieza de JSON). No para: interpretar Retry-After (retry-after-parse). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Computes retry delays for exponential, linear or constant backoff with a cap and optional jitter (full, equal or decorrelated; seeded for reproducibility), and the cumulative wait. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: parsing an HTTP Retry-After value (retry-after-parse). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Computes retry delays for exponential, linear or constant backoff with a cap and optional jitter (full, equal or decorrelated; seeded for reproducibility), and the cumulative wait. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: parsing an HTTP Retry-After value (retry-after-parse). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

base_ms.description: Base delay ms (number; optional; default 500; min 0; max 3600000).

factor.description: Multiplier for exponential (number; optional; default 2; min 1; max 10).

jitter.description: Jitter (optional; one of: none, full, equal, decorrelated; default "none").

max_ms.description: Cap per delay ms (number; optional; default 30000; min 0; max 86400000).

retries.description: Number of retries (integer; optional; default 5; min 1; max 100).

seed.description: Seed for jitter (reproducible) (string; optional; up to 100 chars).

strategy.description: Strategy (optional; one of: exponential, linear, constant; default "exponential").

name: backoff-schedule
title: Plan de reintentos con espera
